scenarios.title: Monza 2026 · the red flag
scenarios.hook: Lights out, Leclerc off at the Parabolica on lap 2 — yellow, Safety Car, red flag, and the whole field files into the pits.

events.title: RED FLAG
events.body: Leclerc and Hamilton touched at the first chicane on the opening lap. A lap later Leclerc went off at the Parabolica, limped half a lap with a damaged car and pulled over before the della Roggia chicane — yellow flags, then the Safety Car, then a red flag at 15:07 local. The race was suspended for half an hour while the field sat parked in the pit lane. It resumed behind the Safety Car on lap 4, and racing went green again at the start of lap 7.

scenarios.title: Monza 2026 · the restart
scenarios.hook: One lap bunched behind the Safety Car, then the release — three green laps of restart scramble, Antonelli climbing.

scenarios.title: Silverstone 2024 · the rain arrives

scenarios.title: Silverstone 2024 · the last laps
scenarios.hook: Hamilton holding Verstappen off, softs against hards, with Norris in range.

scenarios.title: Monza 2024 · the pit cycle
scenarios.hook: Seven laps of stops and undercuts: the timing tower reshuffles as they go.
